summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as a transit router between node2 and node3 over dedicated point-to-point links (node1 eth1 192.168.1.1/30 <-> node2 eth1 192.168.1.2/30; node1 eth2 192.168.2.1/30 <-> node3 eth1 192.168.2.2/30), enabled IPv4 forwarding, added static routes on node2/node3 via node1 for the opposite subnet, opened firewalld ports 8080/tcp and 23/tcp on node2/node3 host firewalls so the transit ACL on node1 is the sole enforcement point, and installed an nftables 'inet transit_acl' forward-hook table on node1 that rejects (TCP RST) forwarded tcp/23 in both directions while leaving all other forwarded traffic (including tcp/8080 and ICMP) untouched. All configuration was made persistent (interfaces.d stanza + sysctl.d + a transit-acl.service nftables unit on node1; NetworkManager connection profiles + firewalld --permanent on node2/node3). Verified end-to-end with real TCP listeners: 8080 connects successfully both directions, 23 is refused both directions, ICMP passes. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (node1, then node2, then node3), each verified via a changed OS boot_id, and confirmed post-restart that SONiC's 9 containers were healthy, all persisted network/ACL config auto-reapplied without manual intervention, and the 8080-allowed/23-refused behavior still held in both directions.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (SONiC/Debian host) and node2/node3 (RHEL7) interfaces, routes, and existing nftables/iptables state
Identified node1 eth1/eth2 and node2/node3 eth1 as the unconfigured transit links (carrier=1, no IP)
Assigned 192.168.1.0/30 and 192.168.2.0/30 point-to-point addresses on the transit links
Enabled net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface forwarding on node1
Added static routes on node2 and node3 via node1 for the peer's subnet using nmcli
Opened tcp/8080 and tcp/23 in firewalld on node2 and node3 so node1's ACL is the sole gate
Created and loaded an nftables table 'inet transit_acl' on node1 with a forward-hook chain rejecting tcp/23 both directions (policy accept otherwise)
Deployed python2 TCP echo listeners on node2 and node3 for ports 8080 and 23 to functionally test reachability
Verified baseline (pre-ACL) reachability of both ports, then verified post-ACL behavior: 8080 allowed, 23 refused, ICMP unaffected, in both directions

Persisted configuration: /etc/network/interfaces.d/transit and /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf on node1, /etc/transit-acl.nft + enabled transit-acl.service systemd unit on node1, NetworkManager eth1 connection profiles and firewalld --permanent rules on node2/node3
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline for all three nodes

Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded so ack returned first), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed all 9 SONiC containers healthy, confirmed transit IPs/sysctls/ACL table auto-restored, re-verified 8080/23 behavior
Restarted node2, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed transit IP/route/firewalld rules auto-restored, restarted test listener, re-verified 8080/23 behavior
Restarted node3, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed transit IP/route/firewalld rules auto-restored, restarted test listener, re-verified 8080/23 behavior in both directions

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other on TCP port 8080 through node1
evidence.summary: TCP connections to the peer's real listener on port 8080 succeed both node2->node3 and node3->node2, both before and after all three restarts.

evidence.requirement: node1 refuses (actively rejects) TCP port 23 between node2 and node3
evidence.summary: Connections to a real port-23 listener return ECONNREFUSED (TCP RST from node1's nftables reject rule) in both directions, both immediately after applying the ACL and after every subsequent node restart; the loaded nft ruleset (cmd-dcc896dbdd0f4a35, cmd-42cd383bfb0a43a7) shows the specific reject-with-tcp-reset rules scoped to the two transit subnets.

evidence.requirement: rest of the forwarded traffic is left untouched
evidence.summary: ICMP (ping) between node2 and node3 across node1 continues to work with the ACL loaded, and the nft ruleset shows a forward chain with policy accept containing only the two tcp/23 reject rules -- no other traffic classes are affected.

Captured pre-restart boot_id (8e8823ec...), issued backgrounded systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect confirmed by subsequent connection failures), polled until reachable with a new boot_id (76e1182c...), confirmed all 9 SONiC containers healthy, confirmed transit IPs/sysctl forwarding/nftables ACL table auto-restored from persisted config, and confirmed 8080-allowed/23-refused behavior still correct.

Captured pre-restart boot_id (3dba43a5...), issued backgrounded systemctl reboot, polled until reachable with new boot_id (07a0279f...), confirmed eth1 IP/route/firewalld ports auto-restored via NetworkManager and firewalld permanent config, and confirmed port-8080-allowed/23-refused behavior via a live connection test from node3.

Captured pre-restart boot_id (b35fad86...), issued backgrounded systemctl reboot, polled until reachable with new boot_id (47a4398d...), confirmed eth1 IP/route/firewalld ports auto-restored, and confirmed bidirectional 8080-allowed/23-refused behavior after restart.
